strings.GUI_idea_guinean_democracy_desc: Guinea is a nation struggling to realize the potential of its government. When Barry Diawadou, the founder of the Republic, had to step down after being defeated by the coalition that formed the Parti Démocratique Guinéen, it was clear this new coalition would test the young democracy. Ahmed Sékou Touré, the coalition's chosen leader, has ruled over the country for a decade now, and he shows no intention of relinquishing power any time soon.
strings.GUI_idea_home_exiled_paigc_desc: Guinea lies south of the Iberian colony of Guiné-Bissau, and has become a home to many exiles from it. When the uprising of the Partido Africano para a Independência da Guiné e Cabo Verde failed, the party was forced to go into exile. Their leader, Amílcar Cabral, has since reestablished the party within our territory and begun preparations for a return.
